reviews.text: Great customer service and my dog is very comfortable with the service.
My babies get groomed here. But last week was my 1st time doing room n board.  I was sad to leave them, but I was worry-free knowing they were in good hands, while I vacation.
They did a wonderful job today on our two pups.  Thank you!!!  We will never return to a Petco or petsmart for grooming again!
The do a great job on my little boy. Patty Martinez should do a research about a business before commenting.

Grateful for Royalty Grooming. My baby had the worst experience at another grooming facility, but Royalty made him feel comfortable and was able to groom him with no problems. Thank you so much! We will be back.
Whomever answer the phone; just quit you sound miserable and god forbid someone ask a question!

This is the only place I trust to watch my dogs or bath my dogs. My oldest acts a complete fool and he is 100lbs. Jumps all over and wrestles. I’m aware of how my dog acts and that he may get a nail too short in the process but they try their hardest not to and feel bad when they do. My youngest is a wild child and runs and wrestles and knocks herself into the kennel sides.

For those reviews complaining of cuts and scratches and soreness did it ever occur to any of you that your dog acts like an idiot and they are working with a creature trying to bite, jump off their tables, ect. Your perfect dog isn’t perfect at this place. I’ve watched the animals been going here for 20 years. I don’t take my animals anywhere else.

To the guy that says it smells like pee, a customer that came in before you probably let his animal poo and pee in the floor and left for staff to clean without a single apology. I’ve also see that when I have been in there. There is also a possibility that one of animals peed on a grooming table, or in their kennel.

To touch base on the guy that lied about his dogs not being fed I’ve left the country and left 150 lbs of dog behind with 30lbs of food and when they ran out they fed them the house food. My dogs wouldn’t eat the house food the first few days. Maybe instead of assuming actually listening to your mistake and your animals behavior you should listen. And those fat and happy dogs you see running around belong to them and they aren’t their getting fed your food😂😂 some are stays that shitty people have abandoned there for them to feed and care for, and they do instead of taking them to a shelter.

As for the fleas again my dogs stay in the outside and inside kennels depending on what type of space they have for when I’m boarding them. I always have them bath my dogs before bringing them home and they have never had fleas. Ever! You can also purchase bravecto. It’s a dog kennel people bring flea infested stays and animals in daily if you didn’t protect your dog from fleas with a product you can’t be mad for being a bad dog owner.

This is a grooming and boarding facility not a vet clinic. They don’t provide shots they allow a clinic to come and do that in the parking lot. If your dog got cut be glad they glued the wound shut and tried to tend to it. As that’s what your dr or a vet would do, guess they could have just sent it home wound open to get infected🤔 but they wouldn’t do that bc they love animals. And consider the fact that some of these dogs are getting hair cuts with scissors jumping around, these groomers are human and doing a job you can’t do but are quick to demean and judge.

I will continue to bring my dogs here for grooming and boarding until the owner retires and sells the place.
Gary is the best and he’s doing an amazing job after Miss Joanne passed away. We have been customers there for over 25 years.

I got my dog groomed here… everything was fine until I got home with my pup. I was petting him and then I noticed a hard clump next to the scarf that they gave him. I looked at it and there was a big bleeding cut that tried to be super glued shut! Also there was a cut that was on his paw but the man told us about the cut.
Great service, good prices. My dog was an old female black lab. We had to get her put down last Saturday June 14th 2025.  Royalty pet center helped a lot over the years.

Guy at the front was extremely rude to my wife when dropping our dog off. When she picked our dog up the same guy said our dog “pissed him off”. Very unprofessional and rude. We then get home and our dog kept licking her private area and we noticed they nicked her in that area and it was irritated. We then also noticed a cut behind her ear.  Haircut was very uneven as well. We still tipped $10 before knowing about all the cuts they gave our dog. They still charged us extra for her being a poodle. We do not Recommend.

I took my dog Charlie for a week and I will say that my dog was treated very well. He was happy when I came to get him. I can tell that he was well taken care of. I will be taking him back soon. Don't let the negative reviews and the outside fool you.
Been taking my little 4 legged baby for the past 10 years to get her nails trimmed and she loves it there.

They Always take good care of my dogs Grooming. It’s suggested that you make an appointment but get there early or they will get full and the walk ins will cause you to be turned around. That one time I decided to make an appointment…. lol.
I will make Royaly Pet Center my dog groomer. It didn't take the groomer long to service my dog. I was very impressed with the care and service.
